title: Inside Sales Representative
summary: The goal of this position is to qualify and convert inbound leads into appointments so our team can make offers to purchase properties. These conversations are the beginning of the customer journey — where we advise and educate home sellers. If you love connecting with people, solving problems, and making a real difference in someone's life, this is the role for you.
responsibilities: Pre-qualify incoming leads and identify appointment opportunities; educate prospects on our value proposition and build trust.
Maintain and utilize the company CRM (Follow Up Boss) and other technology tools, coordinating with the team to schedule seller appointments.
Complete quality assurance follow-up calls on scheduled appointments to ensure an exceptional customer experience.
Follow up with prospects via phone, email, and SMS with consistent and professional communication.
Create and maintain a database of prospective and past clients to ensure all leads are organized and up to date.
Track and report daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs for the company scorecard.
Assist with administrative and team tasks as needed.
qualifications: Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills — you genuinely enjoy talking with people.
Highly motivated to achieve targets and goals in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Strong attention to detail and creative, resourceful thinking.
Quick learner with solid computer literacy.
Proficient in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets).
Experience using a CRM is a plus — we use Follow Up Boss.
Real estate experience is helpful but not required — we provide full training.
whyJoin: Competitive base salary plus commission — top performers earn $100K+.
Be part of Las Vegas's most trusted cash home buying company.
Work with a supportive, close-knit team that celebrates shared success.
Real career growth opportunities as we continue to expand.
Training and mentorship provided — we hire for attitude and teach the rest.

title: Closing Coordinator & Office Manager
summary: We Buy Any Vegas House is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Closing Coordinator & Office Manager to run the back-end of our real estate investment operation. You'll manage transactions from contract to close, keep office operations running smoothly, handle accounting support, and assist leadership with day-to-day needs. This is a wide-ranging role in a small, fast-moving team — the right person thrives on variety and ownership.
responsibilities: Coordinate real estate transactions end to end — open escrow, manage timelines, and communicate with sellers, title companies, and acquisition managers.
Prepare and review settlement statements prior to signing; manage all pre- and post-closing documentation.
Maintain organized transaction files in Podio and physical/digital folders.
Conduct seller introduction calls and maintain regular communication throughout each transaction.
Coordinate walkthroughs, closings, utility transfers, and post-close property transitions.
Wire closing funds and ensure all financial requirements are met on closing day.
Manage office supplies, equipment, and vendor relationships.
Answer calls, handle inquiries, and distribute messages appropriately.
Monitor and delegate tasks to virtual assistants across marketing, accounting, and construction.
Coordinate team meetings, outings, and company events.
Maintain vehicle registrations, smog checks, and related documentation.
Handle supply runs, errands, and other one-off operational tasks as needed.
Track and process invoices in QuickBooks; code credit card transactions and generate reports.
Process vendor payments and collect W9 documents for compliance.
Deposit checks and maintain accurate accounting documentation.
qualifications: Exceptionally organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Tech-savvy — QuickBooks, Excel, Dropbox, and DocuSign experience preferred.
Real estate or administrative experience preferred but not required.
Comfortable wearing multiple hats and supporting leadership across the business.
whyJoin: Competitive salary with a clear progression roadmap.
Be part of Las Vegas's most trusted cash home buying company.
Work directly with leadership and get exposure to every part of the business.
Close-knit team with real growth potential.
Full training provided — we hire for attitude and work ethic.
